justification.text: `2 ≤ n` is Waldschmidt's own range 'for every n ≥ 2', and the registry's note explains the boundary: at n = 1 the bound n^{-c} = 1 exceeds every distance to the nearest integer (≤ 1/2), so the conjecture must start at n ≥ 2.
